variables.name: mSmHandlerObj
variables.comment: The SmHandler object, identifies that message is internal

variables.name: mLogRecords
variables.comment: A list of log records including messages this state machine has processed

variables.name: mIsConstructionCompleted
variables.comment: true if construction of the state machine has not been completed

variables.name: mStateStack
variables.comment: Stack used to manage the current hierarchy of states

variables.name: mTempStateStack
variables.comment: A temporary stack used to manage the state stack

variables.name: mHaltingState
variables.comment: State used when state machine is halted

variables.name: mQuittingState
variables.comment: State used when state machine is quitting

variables.name: mStateInfo
variables.comment: The map of all of the states in the state machine

variables.name: mInitialState
variables.comment: The initial state that will process the first message

variables.name: mDestState
variables.comment: The destination state when transitionTo has been invoked

variables.name: mTransitionInProgress
variables.comment:
* Indicates if a transition is in progress
         *
         * This will be true for all calls of State.exit and all calls of State.enter except for the
         * last enter call for the current destination state.

methods.name: public final void handleMessage(Message msg)
methods.comment:
* Handle messages sent to the state machine by calling
         * the current state's processMessage. It also handles
         * the enter/exit calls and placing any deferred messages
         * back onto the queue when transitioning to a new state.

methods.name: private void performTransitions(State msgProcessedState, Message msg)
methods.comment:
* Do any transitions
         * @param msgProcessedState is the state that processed the message

methods.name: private final void cleanupAfterQuitting()
methods.comment: * Cleanup all the static variables and the looper after the SM has been quit.

methods.name: private final void completeConstruction()
methods.comment: * Complete the construction of the state machine.

methods.name: private final State processMsg(Message msg)
methods.comment:
* Process the message. If the current state doesn't handle
         * it, call the states parent and so on. If it is never handled then
         * call the state machines unhandledMessage method.
         * @return the state that processed the message

methods.name: private final void invokeExitMethods(StateInfo commonStateInfo)
methods.comment:
* Call the exit method for each state from the top of stack
         * up to the common ancestor state.

methods.name: private final void invokeEnterMethods(int stateStackEnteringIndex)
methods.comment: * Invoke the enter method starting at the entering index to top of state stack

methods.name: private final void moveDeferredMessageAtFrontOfQueue()
methods.comment: * Move the deferred message to the front of the message queue.

methods.name: private final int moveTempStateStackToStateStack()
methods.comment:
* Move the contents of the temporary stack to the state stack
         * reversing the order of the items on the temporary stack as
         * they are moved.
         *
         * @return index into mStateStack where entering needs to start

methods.name: private final StateInfo setupTempStateStackWithStatesToEnter(State destState)
methods.comment:
* Set up the mTempStateStack with the states we are going to enter.
         *
         * This is found by searching up the destState's ancestors for a
         * state that is already active i.e. StateInfo.active == true.
         * The destStae and all of its inactive parents will be on the
         * TempStateStack as the list of states to enter.
         *
         * @return StateInfo of the common ancestor for the destState and
         * current state or null if there is no common parent.

methods.name: private final void setupInitialStateStack()
methods.comment: * Initialize StateStack to mInitialState.

methods.name: private final Message getCurrentMessage()
methods.comment: * @return current message

methods.name: private final IState getCurrentState()
methods.comment: * @return current state

methods.name: private final StateInfo addState(State state, State parent)
methods.comment:
* Add a new state to the state machine. Bottom up addition
         * of states is allowed but the same state may only exist
         * in one hierarchy.
         *
         * @param state the state to add
         * @param parent the parent of state
         * @return stateInfo for this state

methods.name: private void removeState(State state)
methods.comment:
* Remove a state from the state machine. Will not remove the state if it is currently
         * active or if it has any children in the hierarchy.
         * @param state the state to remove

methods.name: private final void setInitialState(State initialState)
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#setInitialState(State)

methods.name: private final void transitionTo(IState destState)
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#transitionTo(IState)

methods.name: private final void deferMessage(Message msg)
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#deferMessage(Message)

methods.name: private final void quit()
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#quit()

methods.name: private final void quitNow()
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#quitNow()

methods.name: private final boolean isQuit(Message msg)
methods.comment: Validate that the message was sent by quit or quitNow.

methods.name: private final boolean isDbg()
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#isDbg()

methods.name: private final void setDbg(boolean dbg)
methods.comment: @see StateMachine#setDbg(boolean)
